summary: Load-dimension count must be consistent across capacity and every quantity field in the request.
rule: The array length of vehicles[].capacity (and each alternative in vehicles[].alternative_capacities) must equal the array length of every jobs[].delivery, jobs[].pickup, and shipments[].amount in the same request. vehicles[].min_stop_load must also have the same dimension count. A dimension mismatch is a validation error (HTTP 400).
testingGuidance: Negative: capacity [10,100] but a job delivery [5] (1 dim vs 2) -> HTTP 400 input validation failed.
Positive: capacity [10,100] with all deliveries/pickups/amounts 2-dimensional -> accepted.
Consistency: alternative_capacities with different dimension than primary capacity -> HTTP 400.
Consistency: min_stop_load [20,30] but capacity [10,100] only -> dimension mismatch HTTP 400.
